Alger, 23 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Un: Algiers, August 23, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — A new post office has been inaugurated in the daïra of Azzefoun. This opening is part of the modernization of the Algerian postal network.
Le bureau de poste « Aghrib », situé dan: The "Aghrib" post office, located in the daïra of Azzefoun (wilaya of Tizi Ouzou), has been officially inaugurated. This initiative aims to improve reception conditions for citizens and bring postal services closer to the populations.
